guide_title: Sperrkonto Transfer Guide for GJU Students
guide_desc: How to transfer the funds from Jordan and receive the official embassy document (Sperrbestätigung 006):
guide_step1_desc: Sign up on Expatrio, Fintiba, or Coracle using your Jordanian passport. It typically takes 15–30 minutes to get verified.
guide_step2_desc: Use Arab Bank, Housing Bank, or Cairo Amman Bank with the SWIFT/BIC & IBAN provided in your opening document. Specify OUR for transfer fees.
guide_step3_desc: Once money arrives (2–4 business days), download the official Blocked Amount Confirmation (Sperrbestätigung) PDF.
guide_step4_desc: Print 2 original color copies of the Sperrbestätigung and take them to your visa interview at the German Embassy in Abdoun.
